clue.text: Chinese people introduced to Catholic church by luck

indicators.note: people introduced to a place are brought inside it, so these letters go into the others

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the Han are China's majority ethnic group

explanation.surface: A Chinese group happens upon a Catholic church by accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduced to' is the container signal; 'Chinese people' is one piece, the Han, not two.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: fortune or accident, as in leaving something to luck.

clue.text: Decided on conservative socks

parts.note: hose is an old word for stockings or socks

explanation.surface: Someone settles on a sober, conservative pair of socks.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to have selected or picked something is to have decided on it.

clue.text: Bill's story

definitions.meaning: a bill is a statement of money owed, an invoice
a story is a narrative or report of what happened

explanation.surface: What tale does Bill have to tell?
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a reckoning of charges owed, and a narrated version of events.

clue.text: Frenzied reaction over debut of Navy vessel

indicators.note: something frenzied is wild and disordered, so these letters are scrambled
a debut is a first appearance, so take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A wild response greets the launch of a new naval ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frenzied' rearranges REACTION together with N, the 'debut of Navy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a vessel is any receptacle that holds something, like a jar or tank.

clue.text: Unearth urn depicting mythical king

indicators.note: depicting means showing or containing, so the letters sit within the words

explanation.surface: An archaeologist digs up an urn showing a legendary monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary British ruler of Camelot and the Round Table.

clue.text: Approach downfall without a trace of negativity

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece is wrapped around the other

parts.note: a downfall is a ruin, a collapse

indicators.note: a trace is the smallest amount, here just the first letter

explanation.surface: Coming close to collapse while keeping utterly positive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside: RUIN goes around N.
explanation.definitionFit: Noun sense: the final stretch leading up to an event or race is its approach.

clue.text: Free-thinker's name raised by that woman

parts.note: her is the pronoun for that woman

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to cite is to name or mention

explanation.surface: A woman boosts the profile of a nonconformist thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' works only in a down clue, where it reads ETIC upwards; 'name' is the verb, to cite.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one who rejects orthodox doctrine thinks freely, against church teaching.

clue.text: Willing servant reportedly available immediately

parts.note: ready means willing, as in ready to help

indicators.note: reportedly signals that a word is as heard, not as written

parts.note: a maid is a female servant

explanation.surface: An eager domestic helper, so they say, can start right now.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something prepared in advance and off the shelf can be had at once.

clue.text: Flexible on price of pigs

indicators.note: flexible means able to bend into a new shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Pig sellers are open to negotiation on what they charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective from the Latin for swine, describing anything relating to hogs.

clue.text: Plead with writer to remove page on pleasure excursion

indicators.note: to remove means take out, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument, a writer
a treat is a special outing or entertainment

explanation.surface: An author is begged to cut a page about a day out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to remove' drops P, leaving EN; 'writer' here is the instrument, not the author.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to beg or implore someone earnestly.

clue.text: Pull apart largely dreary books on the French

indicators.note: largely means mostly, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: dismal means dreary, gloomy
NT is the New Testament, a collection of books
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A critic savages some tedious books about the French.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to take something to pieces, as with a machine.

clue.text: About to turn over TV channel ignoring son's opinion

parts.note: re means about, concerning

indicators.note: turn signals the letters being turned round

parts.note: up means over, finished, as in time is up

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: a television station is a channel

explanation.surface: Someone about to switch channels has a view on the programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' reverses UP to PU; 'ignoring' removes S from STATION, leaving TATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the general estimate or regard in which someone is held.

clue.text: Playthings for lads with time for a bit of building

indicators.note: one letter in place of another: this swaps in for that

parts.note: boys are lads

indicators.note: a bit is a small part, here just the first letter

explanation.surface: Building blocks for boys to play with now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' puts T in place of B, the first letter of 'building', in BOYS.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: objects children play with.

clue.text: Attach to stake

definitions.meaning: to fasten or add something on, like a label
to wager money, as on a horse

explanation.surface: Fasten something to a post.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to fix something onto another, and to place a bet.

clue.text: Fixed for each worker attached to hospital department

parts.note: per means for each, as in per person
a man is a worker, as in a hired hand
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

explanation.surface: Every worker is assigned to a hospital department for good.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: lasting or settled, not subject to change.

clue.text: American institute's head taken in by potentially manic pianist for instance

indicators.note: taken in means contained, so these letters go inside the others
potentially means could become, so these letters may rearrange
the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An American institute's director is fooled by a possibly crazed pianist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potentially' gives MCIAN, and 'taken in by' sets the American piece and the head of institute inside it, after the M.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pianist is one kind of performer of music.

clue.text: Winter sports contestant to leave out missing opening of practice on Jersey

indicators.note: missing means lacking, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: to skip is to leave out or omit

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: a jersey is a knitted sweater, called a jumper in Britain

explanation.surface: An athlete skips practice, perhaps to visit the island of Jersey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' takes P from SKIP. Jersey pretends to be the Channel Island.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a competitor who leaps from a snowy ramp in winter games.

clue.text: Attempt to hurry through rehearsal

parts.note: a trial is an attempt or test
to run is to hurry

explanation.surface: Trying to rush through a practice session.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a practice performance before the real thing.

clue.text: Changed man's yet to get a pardon

indicators.note: changed means altered, so these letters are put in new order

explanation.surface: A reformed man still awaits his reprieve.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an official forgiveness of offences, often for a group.

clue.text: Come into effect after section's deleted from guarantee

indicators.note: deleted from means taken out of, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: to insure is to guarantee against loss
S is an abbreviation for section

explanation.surface: A clause takes effect once a section is struck from the warranty.
explanation.definitionFit: Legal sense: to take effect or operate, as a benefit does for someone.

clue.text: A good many start to notice after Unionist politician gains support

indicators.note: after puts the letter from notice at the end, following the other pieces

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament
a tee is a peg that supports a golf ball

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Unionist MP gains backing once people begin to notice.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal sense: a large but unspecified number.

clue.text: Begin to appear tense right away

indicators.note: away means gone, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: drawn means tense, strained

explanation.surface: A strained feeling arrives right off.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb sense: to become evident, as when an idea comes to someone.

clue.text: Tortured Pole's university pal describing resistance as having many uses

indicators.note: describing in its sense of drawing a line around, so these letters enclose another
tortured means twisted, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A tormented Polish student's college friend versatile in resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tortured' gives ALLPUPOSE; 'describing', in the geometric sense of drawing around, encloses R.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: versatile, suitable for a wide range of purposes.

clue.text: Adele's first to depart before you say goodbye

indicators.note: the first of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: to depart this life is to die

indicators.note: say signals a word as spoken, not as written

parts.note: you is spoken as the letter U

explanation.surface: Adele is first to leave, before you can bid her farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: French-derived farewell, used in English for a final parting.

clue.text: Sails manufactured from plant fibre

indicators.note: manufactured means made up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Sails being made from a vegetable fibre.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong fibre from an agave plant, used for rope and matting.

clue.text: Body parts may be found in the field

definitions.text: Body parts may be found in the field

parts.words: Body parts may be found in the field
parts.note: limbs plus a fielding post: in cricket this fielder stands behind the batsman on the leg side

explanation.surface: Remains are discovered out in a meadow.
explanation.walkthrough: Cricket: a fielding position close behind the batsman on the leg side, its name built of lower limbs and a slip.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket sense: a close-catching position, so a fielder is found there in the field.

clue.text: Computer program to facilitate calm

parts.note: an app is a computer application
to ease is to facilitate, make easier

explanation.surface: Software designed to make things run smoothly.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to pacify or placate, often by concessions.

clue.text: Crack revealed in test

parts.note: a crack is an attempt, as in have a crack at it
out means revealed, as in the secret is out

explanation.surface: A fracture shows up in an examination.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a trial run or audition to see if something works.

clue.text: Character perhaps embodied by extremely bashful English engineer

indicators.note: embodied means contained within, so these letters go inside the others
extremely means at the extremes, the first and last letters

parts.note: a rune is a character of an ancient alphabet

explanation.surface: A shy English engineer has a certain character.
explanation.walkthrough: RUNE goes inside B...L. Isambard Kingdom Brunel built the Great Western Railway and famous bridges.
explanation.definitionFit: The nineteenth-century English designer of railways, bridges and steamships.
